text_en: Long ago God spoke to our ancestors in many and various ways by the prophets,
text_cn: 天主在古时，曾多次并以多种方式，藉着先知对我们的祖先说过话。

text_en: but in these last days he has spoken to us by a Son, whom he appointed heir of all things, through whom he also created the worlds.
text_cn: 但在这末期内，他藉着自己的儿子对我们说了话。天主立了他为万有的承继者，并藉着他造成了宇宙。

text_en: He is the reflection of God’s glory and the exact imprint of God’s very being, and he sustains all things by his powerful word. When he had made purification for sins, he sat down at the right hand of the Majesty on high,
text_cn: 他是天主光荣的反映，是天主本体的真像，以自己大能的话支撑万有；当他涤除了罪恶之后，便在高天上坐于“尊威”的右边。

text_en: having become as much superior to angels as the name he has inherited is more excellent than theirs.
text_cn: 他所承受的名字既然超越众天使的名字，所以他远超过众天使之上。

text_en: For to which of the angels did God ever say, “You are my Son; today I have begotten you”? Or again, “I will be his Father, and he will be my Son”?
text_cn: 天主曾向那一位天使说过：“你是我的儿子，我今日生了你？”或说过：“我要作他的父亲，他要作我的儿子？”

text_en: And again, when he brings the firstborn into the world, he says, “Let all God’s angels worship him. ”
text_cn: 再者，当天主引领首生子进入世界的时候，又说：“天主的众天使都要崇拜他。”

text_en: Of the angels he says, “He makes his angels winds, and his servants flames of fire. ”
text_cn: 论到天使固然说过：“天主使自己的天使为风，使自己的仆役为火焰。”

text_en: But of the Son he says, “Your throne, O God, is forever and ever, and the righteous scepter is the scepter of your kingdom.
text_cn: 可是，论到自己的儿子却说：“天主！你的御座，永远常存；你治国的权杖，是公正的权杖。

text_en: You have loved righteousness and hated wickedness; therefore God, your God, has anointed you with the oil of gladness beyond your companions. ”
text_cn: 你爱护正义，憎恨不法；为此天主，你的天主，用欢愉的油傅了你，胜过你的伴侣。”

text_en: And, “In the beginning, Lord, you founded the earth, and the heavens are the work of your hands;
text_cn: 又说：“上主！你在起初奠定了下地，上天是你手的功绩；

text_en: they will perish, but you remain; they will all wear out like clothing;
text_cn: 诸天必要毁灭，而你永远存在；万物必要如同衣裳一样破坏。

text_en: like a cloak you will roll them up, and like clothing they will be changed. But you are the same, and your years will never end. ”
text_cn: 你将它们卷起好似外套，它们必如衣服，都要变换更新；但是你却永存不变，你的寿命无尽无限。”

text_en: But to which of the angels has he ever said, “Sit at my right hand until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet”?
text_cn: 又向那一位天使说过：“你坐在我右边，等我使你的仇敌，变作你脚下的踏板？”

text_en: Are not all angels spirits in the divine service, sent to serve for the sake of those who are to inherit salvation?
text_cn: 众天使岂不都是奉职的神，被派遣给那些要承受救恩的人服务吗？
